theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_pae_compatible_order_invariance
theorems.statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] (e : E ≃ₐ[K] L) (v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E) (w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K L) (r : v.toValuationSubring ≃ₐ[K] w.toValuationSubring), (∀ a : v.toValuationSubring, (r a : L) = e (a : E)) → ∀ f : E, f ≠ 0 → w.ord (e f) = v.ord f
theorems.natural_summary: Factor nonzero f as a unit times an irreducible uniformizer raised to v.ord f. Transport the unit and irreducibility through r and the factorization through e using compatibility. Evaluating the target normalized order gives the same exponent. This matches the accepted prose proof without additional hypotheses.
